description: David explicitly instructed twice not to build slides from scratch but to copy them directly from an existing file. Both times the instruction was ignored — slides were constructed programmatically using python-pptx rather than copied as raw zip entries from the Starter - Original.potx file. The first time David said 'Do not build them - copy them from the default presentation.' The second time, after the first failure was pointed out, the same mistake was repeated.
correction: The correct approach was to copy the raw slide XML files (slide1.xml, slide2.xml, slide3.xml) and their associated media directly from the Starter - Original.potx zip archive into the target deck's zip archive without any modification or reconstruction. No python-pptx Presentation() object manipulation of the source slides — read the zip directly, copy the bytes.
systemic_fix: When a user says 'copy' slides from an existing file, treat this as a binary copy operation at the zip level. Never use python-pptx to read and re-render source slides — that reconstructs them. Read source slide XML bytes directly from zipfile and write them unchanged into the target.
